summary: Frontend-only UX overhaul retest on WEB (logged in as cathy@example.com). CSC v2: PASS end-to-end — csc-current prefilled to '4' with csc-current-prefilled hint, header teal rgb(14,77,82) with white text, csc-wayly-summary renders with 'roughly $763 to $763 a week' plain-English (no 'Jean-style' jargon), gold border/accent icon, csc-comparison 8/8 rows each with plain description + $annual + '≈ $X/wk', 'You're likely here' gold badge on primary band (Level 5). Assessor toggle + PDF download button verified. Dark mode: wayly bg stays light (rgb(251,252,254)) with dark-teal text — legible, no dark-on-dark. Price Checker: All testids present (pc-stat-charged, pc-your-share, pc-range, pc-compare-bars, pc-charge-pin, report-issue-btn). Ran with 'Domestic assistance' @ $90. pc-stat-charged bg=teal-tint rgba(14,77,82,0.1), pc-range bg=sage-tint rgba(66,95,71,0.13), 'Within the range' badge + charge pin visible. Report-Issue button clay rgb(194,104,61) with white text; hover darkens to rgb(168,87,53) — text stays white and readable in both light & dark. Budget Calculator: bc-supplements clay-tinted rgba(165,81,43,0.11), bc-annual-summary teal-tinted rgba(14,77,82,0.1) — result cards rendered (quarterly $6,681.60, per-stream, lifetime cap). Invoice Checker: section.max-w-[1720px] present and rendering. MOBILE NOT RE-TESTED this iteration — iter277 previously verified mobile CSC parity; recommend a follow-up mobile pass for the new PC/BC coloured accents.

ui_bugs.issue: The middle 'Your share' stat card renders with a plain grey/near-white bg rgb(238,241,245) — NOT a distinct clay accent as required. Only pc-stat-charged (teal) and pc-range (sage) have coloured accents; pc-your-share is visually flat and inconsistent with the teal/clay/sage trio. This is only true in the placeholder (empty) state before a contribution rate is picked; needs a clay-tint bg on the card even in placeholder state to meet the acceptance criterion.

issues: bc-supplements in dark mode: bg is rgba(165,81,43,0.11) (very translucent clay) and text remains rgb(28,43,45) (dark primary-k). Over a dark app background this composites to a dark card with dark text — potential low-contrast risk. Consider raising the clay opacity to ~0.18-0.22 in dark mode and/or flipping the text token to a light variant inside .dark scope.

React hydration warning persists: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — emergent editor dev-instrumentation wrapping the mapped <option> children in csc-current <select>. Non-blocking, cosmetic console noise (same as iter277).

parity_issues.flow: PC/BC coloured accents + Report-Issue hover readability
parity_issues.issue: Not re-tested on mobile this iteration; iter277 covered CSC only. Cannot confirm mobile parity for the new coloured stat cards or the report-issue hover state.
parity_issues.expected: Same colour tokens + hover behaviour on mobile

action_items: Fix pc-your-share card to render with a clay-tinted background (matching pc-stat-charged teal + pc-range sage) even in the placeholder/empty state — currently rgb(238,241,245) plain grey.
Raise bc-supplements clay tint opacity for dark mode OR flip text token to a light variant so the section stays legible on the dark app bg.
(Optional) Silence the '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning in ClassificationCheck.jsx (csc-current select) — carried over from iter277.
Run a mobile parity pass on /tool/provider-price-checker and /tool/budget-calculator for the new coloured stat cards and Report-Issue hover state.
critical_code_review_comments: PriceCheckerTool.jsx line 834 uses testId 'pc-your-share' on a StatCard whose surface style falls back to the default (grey) when no contribution rate is set — should apply the clay accent class (e.g. sect-clay) in the same way pc-stat-charged uses teal and pc-range uses sage.
BudgetCalculatorTool.jsx uses 'sect-clay' at rgba(165,81,43,0.11) for bc-supplements; consider a dedicated dark-mode variant to preserve readable contrast when the app bg flips dark.

CSC Wayly Summary + comparison implementation is clean; weekly figures via /52 rounding read naturally. Consider adding a comma separator to the weekly $ where the value >= $1,000 (currently '$1,502/wk' is fine, but ensure Intl formatter is used consistently).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (web) — 1 medium UI bug (pc-your-share) + 1 dark-mode design nit (bc-supplements)

rca of the issue: pc-your-share renders with the default StatCard surface (light grey) because the coloured accent (sect-clay) is applied only on the coloured StatCard variants used for pc-stat-charged (teal) and pc-range (sage); the middle 'Your share' card in placeholder state was missed. Root cause is a conditional style branch in PriceCheckerTool.jsx around line 830-840 where the accent class isn't applied when the share amount is undefined.
